faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Discovery V8 use?
faqLeft.a: The Discovery V8 uses the AJ41 petrol V8 — a 3.9-litre unit in the D1 generation and a 4.0-litre unit in the D2 generation.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Discovery V8 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £4,500. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Discovery V8?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact AJ41 engine spec before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ41 Discovery V8 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, valve seals, coolant components and bearings as standard on every AJ41 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Discovery V8 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Discovery V8 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Discovery V8 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Discovery V8 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
